verses.en: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.
verses.sm: Filisitia O le afioga a le ALII na oo mai ia Ieremia le perofeta ia Filisitia, a o lei fasia Kasa e Farao.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall be an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land, and all that is therein; the city, and them that dwell therein: then the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl.
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, Faauta, e oso mai le vai mai le itu i matu, e fai foi ma vaitafe e lofia ai; e lofia ai le nuu, ma mea ua tumu ai, o le aai foi, ma e O nonofo ai; ona alalaga ai lea o tagata, ma uio atoa uma o e nonofo i le nuu.

verses.en: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong horses, at the rushing of his chariots, and at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands;
verses.sm: Ona o le pa6 o le pana o atigivae o ona solofanua malolosi, ma le osooso o ona kariota, ma le taalili o ana mea taavavale, e le tetepa i tua o tama i a latou fanau, aua e vaivai o latou lima;

verses.en: Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines, and to cut off from Tyrus and Zidon every helper that remaineth: for the LORD will spoil the Philistines, the remnant of the country of Caphtor.
verses.sm: ona o le aso O le a 00 mai e faatafunaina ai Filisitia uma, e vavaeeseina fesoasoani uma ua totoe i Turo ma Saitonu; aua e faatafunaina e le ALII o Filisitia, o e ua totoe o le nuu tuloto o Kafetori.

verses.en: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?
verses.sm: s Ua selemamaina ulu o e i Kasa; ua faaumatia Asekelona ma e o totoe i lo latou vanu; e te selei ea ia te oe seia afea?

verses.en: O thou sword of the LORD, how long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.
verses.sm: Aue! le pelu a le ALII e, e te le mapu ea seia afea? ia e foi atu i lou faamoega, ina malolo ia, ma ia e alala.

verses.en: How can it be quiet, seeing the LORD hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.
